name: North Richland Hills
registryAssessment: The City of North Richland Hills exposes an official public ArcGIS EnerGov map service whose Parcels layer is a local municipal parcel map/registry source. The service metadata describes the service as TAD Parcels; this is local GIS evidence, not a claim that the layer is a complete or current legal cadastre.

officialSources.observation: Search discovery identified the official interactive map and municipal map context; direct fetch returned HTTP 403 during this attempt. The linked official NRH Maps service was accessible anonymously.

officialSources.role: Official City of North Richland Hills ArcGIS EnerGov MapServer
officialSources.observation: HTTP 200; service CRS is ESRI 102738 / NAD 1983 StatePlane Texas North Central FIPS 4202 Feet; layers include Parcels (layer 15), and supported query formats include JSON and GeoJSON.

HTTP 200; polygon layer with public Map/Query/Data capabilities. Safe native identity fields observed were OBJECTID and ParcelId. Unsafe owner, address, legal-description, and account fields were not requested.

geometryDecision.reason: The exact WUP point query returned one anonymous parcel feature with safe fields OBJECTID=21343 and ParcelId=P21485. A bounded nearby envelope query also returned three polygon geometries; one was retained after reducing properties to the canonical native ParcelId only.

coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Public service/layer metadata and anonymous exact-point and bounded ID+geometry responses were verified. Complete current citywide parcel coverage was not independently proven.
